messages.msg_0122_D39R0101_00000: You see the item over there? It was me who dropped it, but I cannot get over there to pick it up. Why? Walking on ice makes your feet freeze! My shoes are so worn that the soles are gone!
messages.msg_0122_D39R0101_00001: You see the item over there? It was me who dropped it, but I cannot get over there to pick it up. Why? Walking on ice makes your feet freeze! My shoes are so worn that the soles are gone!
messages.msg_0122_D39R0101_00002: The item you picked up over there... it was an HM, wasn’t it? I am the one who dropped it...but I want you to keep it. You took the time to get it, right? It contains Waterfall. Have fun climbing waterfalls! Me? I still need a new pair of shoes before I can enjoy waterfalls.
messages.msg_0122_D39R0101_00003: Me oh my... Is that you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}? Fancy meeting you here! To tell the truth...my sandals are frozen on the ice, and I am stuck here. In other words, my flip-flops are quick-frozen to the ground. Tee hee. Well, it’s no laughing matter. Would you come around and push my back?
